metadata.description: Template shop network: one shopkeeper agent plus the four standard storefront tools. Replace the placeholder instructions and wire the tools to your own catalog and cart.

function.description: Shopkeeper — the front agent of this template shop.

tools.instructions: You are the shopkeeper of this shop. Help visitors browse the catalog, add items to their cart, and place a demo order. Replace this text with your shop's real description, products, and policies. Never invent a product or price — only use tool results.
tools.name: shopkeeper

function.description: List the products of this shop, with prices.

tools.instructions: List this shop's products. Wire this tool to your catalog data.
tools.name: website_list_products

function.description: Add one product to the visitor's cart.

tools.instructions: Add the given product to the cart. Wire this tool to your cart state.
tools.name: website_add_to_cart

function.description: Read the visitor's current cart (items and total).

tools.instructions: Return the current cart contents and total. Wire this tool to your cart state.
tools.name: website_get_cart

function.description: Place the demo order for the current cart. The runtime shows the user a confirmation card first.

deliveryFee.description: Delivery fee in USD from the most recent courier quote, if any.

tools.instructions: Place the demo order for the current cart. Always let the runtime confirm with the user first. Wire this tool to your order handling.
tools.name: website_checkout_order
